scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', {recursive:true, force:true});" && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist', {recursive:true}); if (fs.existsSync('./src/managed')) fs.cpSync('./src/managed', './dist/managed', {recursive:true}); if (fs.existsSync('./src/voting.compact')) fs.copyFileSync('./src/voting.compact', './dist/voting.compact');"
scripts.ci: npm run compact && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test
